temperature.fitted_on: cal_temperature (3,150 synthetic calibration cases), NLL grid

abstention.rule: smallest grid value whose cal_policy CP95 UPPER bound of selective risk <= 0.05
abstention.fitted_on: cal_policy (3,150), disjoint from every reported set

response_semantics.decide: softmax(logits / T) over the valid options; argmax is the choice
response_semantics.abstain: max calibrated probability < tau -> choice null, reason_code below_validated_threshold

reason_codes.below_validated_threshold: max calibrated probability below tau; the 5 % selective-risk budget was validated on the held-out synthetic test (E42), both seeds

bounds: guarantee protocol- and distribution-specific (synthetic families); real-image abstention not validated (see model card)
